name: code-oracle-mcp
description: Multi-language type-aware resolution MCP over a warm LSP session (tsgo for TS/JS, ty for Python) — sibling to code-map. Isolated here so code-map's core stays zero-heavy-dep.
_dependencyNote: The tsgo LSP still ships via @typescript/native-preview, not GA typescript (tsc only). Pin EXACT to a known-good day; package installs launch the platform-native executable directly while TSGO_BIN may still name a Node launcher. TypeScript 5 and @types/node are exact, lockfile-managed dev tools. Python defaults to exact ty 0.0.50 through uvx; TY_BIN (or legacy TY_CMD) may override the launcher.
